role: Gate: rebuilds every section record of the oracle's MeshProbe/MeshScene dumps from chunks.bin through the native chunk mesher (render_blocks) and compares int for int; in scene mode sections with unported render types are reported as skipped by type.

structs.name: record
structs.java: one sections.bin record: a chunk section's tessellated vertex ints for one render pass

notes: Test harness, built with -Dmain=gate_test_main behind tests/input_guard.c; not linked into the product and never on the tick path. make -C csrc test runs it on every directory under out/java/meshes. Native calls: rb_manifest_load, rb_table_load, rb_atlas_load, rb_world_load, rb_world_block, rb_mesher_init, rb_tess_init, rb_mesh_section and their _free (csrc/engine/render_blocks.h). Two modes: spawn radius walk (MeshProbe) and file-order scene walk (manifest scene:true). Directories without chunks.bin (old mp-s1/mp-s42) are skipped. Oracle side: oracle/harness/netherite/oracle/MeshProbe.java, MeshScene.java. Recordings: out/java/meshes/mesh-s1, mesh-s42, scene-2, scene-42, scene3-2, scene3-2-fast, scene3-42. RenderBlocks member names are representative, not an exhaustive list of what is ported; record field names summarised.
